title: Order the feature phase
intro: The loop you'll run for every roadmap phase — put it in order.
prompt: Drag into sequence, first step on top.

steps.text: Fresh agent context + a new feature branch
The agent interviews you about scope, decisions, and done-criteria
plan.md, requirements.md, validation.md written and reviewed
Commit the spec — before any implementation
"Implement this plan" — the agent builds it
High-altitude review vs the spec; fixes go through the agent
Check off the roadmap phase, merge, delete the branch

debrief: The order is the discipline: the interview comes before the documents, the documents are committed before the code, and validation happens against the written spec rather than your memory. The two easiest steps to skip — committing the spec before implementing, and deleting the branch after merging — are exactly the ones that keep the history clean and the next feature cheap.
